snippet.title: Riddlewood Manor Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Riddlewood Manor is finally here! Step inside the haunted halls in this brand new gameplay trailer, featured in the Indie Horror Showcase.

Explore the twisted rooms of the manor, solve eerie puzzles, and survive encounters with dark forces determined to end your stay. Every corner hides a secret—and every choice might be your last. Optional jump scare warning is available for those who dare to tread carefully.

🎮 Play now on Steam 👉 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3019550/Riddlewood_Manor/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer
